title: Noice Brush
description: Automatically selects a random block from your hotbar to help create textured builds.
body:
# 🎨 Noise Brush
Noise Brush is a lightweight client-side utility mod for Fabric designed to streamline the texturing process. It automatically switches your hotbar slot to a random block after every placement, allowing builders to effortlessly create "noise" patterns and textured surfaces.

Stop scrolling your mouse wheel manually — let the mod handle the randomness!

![How work:](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/T27NdsRF/images/3e170b47b6230960417100946d4a54a4badb8c65.gif)

# ✨ Features
Automatic Randomization: Just hold Right Click to build, and the mod will pick a random block from your hotbar for the next placement.

Smart Filtering: The mod only switches to slots containing Blocks. It ignores tools, food, and empty slots.

True Random: The algorithm allows the same block to be selected twice in a row for natural-looking distribution.

Client-Side Only: Works on any server (Vanilla, Spigot, Paper) without being installed on the server side.

Toggleable: Turn it on/off instantly with a keybind.

# 🎮 How to use
Fill your hotbar with the palette blocks you want to mix (e.g., Stone, Cobblestone, Andesite).

Press R (default) to toggle the mod.

You will see an overlay message: Random Build Mode: ON.

Start building! The mod will swap slots automatically after each block you place.

# 📦 Installation
Requires **_Fabric Loader_**.

Requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).

Just drop the **.jar** into your **mods** folder.
